import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots for a comprehensive view
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top Products by Revenue
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(8)
axes[0, 0].barh(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values, color='#8B4513')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Revenue by Product', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(product_revenue.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(v, i, f' ${v:.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group and Payment Method
age_payment = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'payment_method'])['total'].sum().unstack()
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_payment = age_payment.reindex(age_order)
age_payment.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 1], stacked=False, width=0.8, 
                 color=['#D2691E', '#CD853F', '#DEB887'])
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Revenue by Age Group and Payment Method', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Payment Method', fontsize=9)
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Takeaway vs Dine-in Analysis
takeaway_stats = df.groupby('is_takeaway').agg({'total': 'sum', 'quantity': 'sum'}).reset_index()
takeaway_stats['is_takeaway'] = takeaway_stats['is_takeaway'].map({0: 'Dine-in', 1: 'Takeaway'})
x = range(len(takeaway_stats))
width = 0.35
bars1 = axes[1, 0].bar([i - width/2 for i in x], takeaway_stats['total'], 
                       width, label='Revenue ($)', color='#8B4513')
ax2 = axes[1, 0].twinx()
bars2 = ax2.bar([i + width/2 for i in x], takeaway_stats['quantity'], 
                width, label='Quantity', color='#D2691E', alpha=0.7)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Order Type', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, color='#8B4513')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Quantity', fontsize=11, color='#D2691E')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Comparison', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(x)
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(takeaway_stats['is_takeaway'])
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#8B4513')
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#D2691E')
lines1, labels1 = axes[1, 0].get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
axes[1, 0].legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper left', fontsize=9)

# 4. Average Transaction Value by Size
size_avg = df.groupby('size')['total'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors_size = sns.color_palette('YlOrBr', len(size_avg))
wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[1, 1].pie(size_avg.values, labels=size_avg.index, 
                                           autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                           colors=colors_size)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Transaction Value by Size', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
for text in texts:
    text.set_fontsize(11)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
